verdict.rationale: Vanta's questionnaire-automation page documents AI that combs your security documentation knowledge base and previous questionnaires to generate responses for new questionnaires. It also states the user only needs to review, approve, and submit, so the core 'AI drafts I review' flow is first-party documented. However, the evidence never explicitly says questionnaire answers are grounded in live Vanta controls or test data; only Trust Center's separate AI answers mention live controls. Support rests solely on vendor marketing with no independent corroboration, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that questionnaire drafts draw from actual controls and evidence, detail on the draft review workflow such as citations or confidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, security questionnaires get answered by AI from my actual controls and knowledge base — drafts I review, not blank spreadsheets I fill
